title: The Local Lab Audit
summary: Audit a controlled local service and deliver actionable findings.
description: Combine local service investigation, HTTP inspection, vulnerable input handling, access-control reasoning, and security concept classification. Submit a report with evidence, impact, and remediation. All targets and records are synthetic, remain inside the local lab container, and require no external systems.
learning_objectives: Verify a local service and request path

workspace_seed.audit-target/README.txt: Synthetic combined target notes. Local service: http://127.0.0.1:8080. Input demo: /search?q=NAME. Access-control demo: /record?id=1002.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Use an audit structure: finding, evidence, impact, remediation. Verify each observation against the synthetic application before writing the report.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Review `audit-target/` and query the local service on 127.0.0.1:8080. The manifest notes which two security behaviours the demo intentionally illustrates.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Write `audit-report.json` with `service_verified: true`, `input_handling: "unsafe_sql_query"`, `access_control: "missing_object_authorization"`, `base64: "encoding"`, `sha256: "hashing"`, and a non-empty `remediation` string.

completion_explanation: You completed The Local Lab Audit. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: Private local-only services; no public Internet route.
